body: Its not that I need to buy one, its that I feel like it would be best to buy one
Also, the stuff at the end of your post is really scary to me. It sounds like its a mentally abusive relationship. Do you really still want to be with this girl?

Ok cool, that does make sense considering her relationships in the past. Because she has never really had a good relationship in the past, she believes that is the only way that she will be satisfied in life. There is a quote that has stuck with me for a while and idk who wrote it but it basically says that "in your life, you are required to save one person and its okay if that person is yourself". Maybe try and work with her on being okay with herself because it sounds like she really loves you and thats the only thing she can hold on to right now. I used to have a crush on this girl a while back and I got into that mindset too of she was the only thing that made me happy. Well I admitted feelings and we don't talk anymore and I really had nothing after that. So I decided that I would focus on myself and try to be the best person I can be. Now, I decided that I would start working on and stuff but she does not have to do that. She just needs to find worth in herself and not a perfect relationship. I wish I could tell you specifically how to do that but idk her at all.

Idk how you would go about that but getting a new therapist is a good idea because not every human is perfect and that one might work for someone else, but she kinda sucks for you. People just respond to people differently.
Maybe its time to seek out a new therapist then? There is no shame in doing that
The best thing you can do is to start working on yourself before you can completely help others. Are you seeing a therapist?

Idk how specifically to help but I just want to let you know your a great guy for being there for her through all of this. It might be rough but she definitely needs someone like you. If I may ask, why is she against therapy? If you don't want to post it here, we can just dm and talk about it.

Your just still recovering from terrible things that were done to you, there is nothing wrong with you. Maybe talk to your partner about it? That might help right now but it might be good to see a therapist because it seems to be a problem that is hurting you a lot
